claim: On the included deterministic scenarios, the pack identifies and replays the first step at which an initially admissible request becomes inadmissible under the existing Authority, Scope, Freshness, Replay or State checks.
claim_boundary: See CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md and the temporal README.

scenarios.description: A valid request becomes inadmissible after the freshness window. The Freshness property fails; the other five remain satisfied.
A recognised principal is removed from the recognised authority set between two checks. A fresh nonce isolates the failure to the Authority property.
A new signed request is issued with a narrowed granted_scopes set that no longer covers the required_scope. Scope fails; the signature remains valid because the new request is freshly signed.
Live state drifts between two checks. A fresh nonce-bearing request is re-issued so the failure isolates to the State property rather than Replay.
A valid request runs once and is then re-submitted unchanged. Replay protection denies the second submission. Total mutation count remains exactly one.
